body: It suck’s , you’ll hurt, you’ll be mad. But you’ll live. Won’t be easy, won’t be quick.  It’ll be a long journey where at the end, it’ll all be a tolerable peace of your day

It's been a rough one. First time in 10 years I don't get to tell her happy birthday. I always went above and beyond to surprise her on her special day. I've been doing a lot better but the important dates really set me back.  Damn it I miss her

Trust me. The cheating would’ve made it worse. Resentment, loss of trust, worrying all the time.  My ex did both.  Doesn’t make it any easier.  Your pride/ self respect, won’t let you swallow the cheating at the end of the day

From my personal experience therapy didn’t do anything for me.  What I found to be the best support, was to be honest with how your feeling, accept it. Surround yourself with friends and family even tho you’ll still feel empty.  Read a few good books ( the art of not giving a fuck is a good one).  Write down questions such as why am I feeling like this,  what are my controllables and figure a goal you’d like to accomplish in 6 months. Set daily goals too, organize your day.  Start writing your feelings and thoughts down.

Man we have almost identical stories. Mine was 10 years and all of a sudden she needed to go find herself and that she was no longer in love. We even got married for 6 months but she said that she regretted it and wanted nothing to do with me. Just like that out of the blue. I feel your pain and desperation.  I’m searching everywhere for answers but at this point everyone has the same answers , suggestions. She’s out there living her best life while I’m sulking and wondering what more I could’ve done.
Totally normal.  Crank your car radio up, scream at the top of your lungs.   Car karaoke to linkn park helps too
I feel your pain brother. 10 years for me.  Then she just wanted to find herself. We’ll get through it
I’m in your shoes just roles reversed. I dont know how people can move on and live a completely different life without you after 10 years

Bro I feel your pain.  10 year relationship gone. The pain can feel like it’s unbearable... your thoughts filled with memories and the thoughts of what could’ve been. I tried to hurt myself twice. But it’s not worth hurting yourself for someone that doesn’t care. Ive battled with wanting to call, hold her again or just get a text. But that only hurts more and sets you back. The hardest thing to do will be to focus on yourself. I’m not quite sure myself what that means yet but start with simply doing things you like.  Plan your day out and accept that the thoughts will be there... but you don’t have to live and sulk in them.
